posts.text:
Would you Rather:

have an aries fall for you in 4 minutes

OR

have an aries fall off a scooter in 4 minutes

(it's the same aries. it's the same 4 minutes)
posts.caption: Aries is the cardinal fire sign that does everything at full speed, including falling in love and falling off rental scooters. Ruled by Mars, they commit instantly and think about it later. Which one would you pick?

posts.text: Warning: Aries has the power to start a fight, win the fight, forget the fight, and ask you why you're being so quiet at dinner.
posts.caption: Aries placements burn hot and cool off fast, which is great for them and confusing for everyone else at the table. Mars energy means the argument is over the second they decide it is. Has an Aries ever done this to you?

posts.text:
Why you should let an aries plan the trip

1) we'll leave in 20 minutes
2) we will not have a hotel
3) we will race a stranger at the airport
4) we will win

Anyway we're leaving in 20 minutes
posts.caption: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac and treats every vacation like a starting gun. Spontaneous, competitive and allergic to itineraries, they will get you there first even if nobody knows where there is. Would you get in the car?

posts.text:
Life as an aries moon

One second i'm starting a new hobby

The next i'm selling the equipment on marketplace

Great condition. used once. with passion
posts.caption: An Aries moon falls in love with new projects at first sight and leaves just as fast. The passion is real, it just has a short shelf life. What hobby did you quit within a week?

posts.text:
yes that 5'7 taurus sun who has eaten the same breakfast for six years and refuses to walk faster than 2mph is definitely your soulmate go ask them where they want to eat right now

(they already know. it's the usual)
posts.caption: Taurus is the fixed earth sign ruled by Venus, which means comfort, routine and very strong opinions about food. They are slow to change and even slower to walk, but endlessly loyal once they pick you. Does your Taurus order the same thing every time?

posts.text: Venus in Taurus core is saying i'm on a budget and then spending $38 on a candle because it smelled like a cabin i've never been to
posts.caption: Venus is at home in Taurus, so these placements love luxury, texture and anything that smells expensive. The budget was real, the candle was just more real. What is your Venus in Taurus purchase?

posts.text: PSA: a taurus is not ignoring you. a taurus is lying horizontally and has entered power saving mode. please try again after snacks.
posts.caption: Taurus energy is famously grounded, sensual and deeply committed to rest. When a bull is recharging, there is no rushing them, only feeding them. What snack brings your Taurus back online?

posts.text:
Taurus logic

Either i get my way

Or i simply do not move until the world gets tired

So technically i always get my way
posts.caption: Taurus is the most stubborn fixed sign in the zodiac, and they know patience is a weapon. They do not argue, they outlast. Have you ever won a standoff with a Taurus?

posts.text:
Things a gemini is doing right now

1) texting you
2) texting three group chats
3) learning portuguese
4) quitting portuguese
5) starting a podcast about quitting portuguese

They will reply in 3-5 business years
posts.caption: Gemini is the mutable air sign ruled by Mercury, so their brain is basically forty open tabs and a podcast mic. Curious about everything and committed to nothing for long, they are never boring. How many tabs does your Gemini have open?

posts.text: Warning: Gemini has the power to forget your birthday and then remember a sentence you said in 2019 word for word, including the punctuation.
posts.caption: Mercury rules Gemini, which gives them a memory that is selective, weirdly detailed and mostly about words. Dates fall out, quotes stay forever. What has a Gemini quoted back to you?

posts.text:
Would you Rather:

hear a gemini's side of the story

OR

hear both of a gemini's sides of the story

OR

be a sandwich
posts.caption: Gemini is the sign of the twins, so every story comes with at least two versions and a director's cut. Honestly it is entertaining every single time. Which option are you choosing?

posts.text: Gemini rising core is having eleven hobbies, zero of them finished, and somehow still being the most interesting person at the party because i can explain all eleven
posts.caption: A Gemini rising meets the world with curiosity, quick wit and a conversation for every room. They may not finish the pottery class, but they will tell you everything they learned in week one. How many unfinished hobbies are you carrying?

posts.text: PSA: if a cancer says "i'm fine" please check the fridge. if they made soup, they are not fine. if they made soup for you, you are now family and you cannot leave.
posts.caption: Cancer is the cardinal water sign ruled by the moon, so feelings come out as home cooking. They nurture everyone around them, especially when they are quietly struggling. What does your Cancer make when they are not fine?

posts.text:
Being a cancer moon is wild

One second i'm healed

The next i'm looking at a photo of a bench we sat on in 2017

It's a nice bench. i miss the bench
posts.caption: The moon is at home in Cancer, which makes these placements the most nostalgic people in the zodiac. Healing is real, but so is that one bench. What random object makes you emotional?

posts.text: yes that 5'4 cancer sun who saves every receipt from your first date, calls their mom twice a day and cries at dog food commercials is definitely your soulmate go let them cook for you right now
posts.caption: Cancer suns are sentimental, family-oriented and loyal to the bone. They will remember your coffee order, your bad week and the exact restaurant from your first date. Do you know a Cancer who keeps every receipt?

posts.text: Warning: Cancer has the power to remember the exact thing you said at 11:42pm three summers ago and bring it up gently, with snacks, during a nice moment.
posts.caption: Cancer placements have emotional memory like a filing cabinet, and every file is labeled with a date and time. They never forget, but they are very sweet about it. What has a Cancer brought up years later?

posts.text: Leo sun core is getting a compliment on my hair and then thinking about it for the next 4-6 business days like it was a lifetime achievement award
posts.caption: Leo is ruled by the sun, so a single sincere compliment can power them for a week. They shine brightest when they feel seen, and their hair is usually the headline. What compliment has lived in your head rent free?

posts.text:
Why you should date a leo

1) we'll hype you up in public
2) we'll hype you up in private
3) we'll make you a playlist
4) the playlist is mostly us

Anyway the playlist slaps
posts.caption: Leo is the most generous, warm and affectionate fixed fire sign, and they love loudly. You will feel like a celebrity, and they will feel like the headliner. Would you listen to the Leo playlist?

posts.text:
Would you Rather:

be adored by a leo

OR

be a lion's favorite throw pillow

(it's a lot of the same responsibilities)
posts.caption: Being loved by a Leo means constant affection, big gestures and occasionally being sat on for attention. Ruled by the sun, they give warmth and expect a little in return. Which one are you choosing?

posts.text: Warning: Leo has the power to walk into a room, find the best lighting in under 3 seconds, and stand in it for the entire evening.
posts.caption: Leo placements have a natural instinct for the spotlight, literally. Their main character energy comes with an internal light meter. Have you ever watched a Leo find their angle?

posts.text:
Things my virgo moon did today

1) reorganized the spice rack
2) alphabetized the spice rack
3) worried about the spice rack
4) fixed your life, unprompted

You're welcome. also you're out of cumin
posts.caption: A Virgo moon finds emotional peace through order, routines and helping whether you asked or not. Ruled by Mercury, they notice every detail, including what is missing from your kitchen. What has a Virgo fixed for you unprompted?

posts.text: PSA: when a virgo says "just one small note" please sit down. there are fourteen notes. they are color coded. they are correct.
posts.caption: Virgo is the mutable earth sign of precision, analysis and helpful feedback. Their criticism comes from caring, and annoyingly, it is usually right. How many notes did your Virgo leave last time?

posts.text: yes that 5'6 virgo sun who reads the terms and conditions, carries three kinds of hand cream and has rewritten your resume without asking is definitely your soulmate go let them fix your spreadsheet right now
posts.caption: Virgo suns show love through acts of service, which is a fancy way of saying they will reorganize your whole life. Practical, devoted and always prepared, they are the partner who packs the band-aids. Has a Virgo ever read the fine print for you?

posts.text:
Virgo logic

If i plan every detail nothing can go wrong

And if something goes wrong it means i didn't plan enough

So anyway i'm up at 3am planning brunch
posts.caption: Virgo placements treat anxiety like a project management tool. Their Mercury-ruled minds never fully clock out, especially before a group event. What are you overplanning this week?

posts.text:
Would you Rather:

have a libra pick the restaurant

OR

have a raccoon pick the restaurant

(the raccoon will decide faster)
posts.caption: Libra is the cardinal air sign of balance, which means every choice gets weighed from twelve angles. They want everyone to be happy, so nobody gets to eat. Who is picking dinner in your friend group?

posts.text: Venus in Libra core is agreeing with both sides of an argument, sincerely, and then going home and making a pros and cons list about which friend to text first
posts.caption: Venus rules Libra, which makes these placements natural diplomats who hate conflict and love harmony. They see every perspective and feel every one of them. Are you the friend who stays neutral?

posts.text: Warning: Libra has the power to make you feel like the most fascinating person alive and then not text back for three days because they couldn't pick an emoji.
posts.caption: Libra charm is legendary, and so is the indecision behind it. They are trying to send the perfect reply, it just takes a few business days. Has a Libra ever left you waiting?

posts.text:
Being a libra is wild

One second i'm fighting for justice

The next i've spent 40 minutes picking a font for my grocery list

Both were urgent honestly
posts.caption: Libra carries the scales of justice and an elite eye for aesthetics, often at the same time. Fairness and beauty both matter, and they refuse to rank them. What do you spend way too long making pretty?

posts.text: Warning: Scorpio has the power to find your childhood soccer team photo in under 6 minutes using only your first name and a vibe.
posts.caption: Scorpio is the fixed water sign ruled by Pluto, and their research skills belong in a detective agency. Nothing stays hidden from a curious Scorpio for long. How fast can your Scorpio find something?

posts.text:
yes that 5'10 scorpio moon who has said nine words to you total, remembers all of yours, and owns exclusively black hoodies is definitely your soulmate go tell them one secret right now

(they already know it)
posts.caption: A Scorpio moon is intense, private and quietly observant, so they are always listening even when they are silent. They give little away and notice everything. Who is the quiet Scorpio in your life?

posts.text:
Why you should tell a scorpio your secrets

1) we'll never tell anyone
2) we'll never forget it
3) we'll never tell you our secrets
4) that's the deal

Signed under a full moon, no refunds
posts.caption: Scorpio is the most loyal vault in the zodiac, but trust is a one-way door until they decide otherwise. Ruled by Pluto, they value depth, privacy and very long memories. Would you take the deal?

posts.text: PSA: a scorpio did not "just happen" to see your story 4 seconds after you posted it. a scorpio has been sitting there. a scorpio was waiting. a scorpio is fine.
posts.caption: Scorpio placements play it cool, but their notifications are always on for the people they care about. Intensity is their love language, even when they pretend otherwise. Is your Scorpio always first to view your story?

posts.text:
Sagittarius logic

Either i find myself in another country

Or i lose myself in another country

Either way i'm booking the flight tonight
posts.caption: Sagittarius is the mutable fire sign ruled by Jupiter, the planet of expansion, adventure and slightly reckless optimism. Every problem looks smaller from a window seat. Where would your Sagittarius book tonight?

posts.text:
Would you Rather:

tie down a sagittarius

OR

tie a bow on a weather balloon

(the balloon has better odds)
posts.caption: Sagittarius values freedom above almost everything, so commitment needs room to roam. They love deeply, just with the windows open. Which one are you choosing?

posts.text: Sagittarius sun core is saying "i'm so blunt it's a gift" and then telling the barista their latte art looks like a sad little horse
posts.caption: Sagittarius is the zodiac's truth teller, honest to the point of accidental comedy. Their symbol is the centaur archer, so honestly the horse comment is personal. What is the bluntest thing a Sag has said to you?

posts.text: Warning: Sagittarius has the power to say the most accurate, unforgivable thing about your situationship and then immediately ask if you want to go on a road trip.
posts.caption: Sagittarius friends deliver hard truths with zero warning and an adventure as the chaser. Jupiter makes them blunt, generous and impossible to stay mad at. Has a Sag ever read your situationship like this?

posts.text: yes that 6'0 capricorn sun who replies "noted" to your paragraph, owns one good coat and has a five year plan with your name in pencil is definitely your soulmate go schedule a meeting about it right now
posts.caption: Capricorn is the cardinal earth sign ruled by Saturn, so romance comes with a timeline and a budget. They are reserved at first, but once you make the plan, it is permanent ink. Has a Capricorn ever replied noted to your paragraph?

posts.text:
My capricorn moon's self care routine

1) answer emails
2) answer emails in a candlelit bath
3) make a spreadsheet of my feelings
4) close the spreadsheet

Great session. see you next fiscal year
posts.caption: A Capricorn moon processes emotions through productivity, structure and the occasional spreadsheet. Rest feels suspicious, so they make it efficient. What does self care actually look like for you?

posts.text: PSA: a capricorn is not emotionally unavailable. they are emotionally available by appointment, between 6:15 and 6:30pm, after the gym, if you book in advance.
posts.caption: Capricorns get called emotionally unavailable, but really their feelings just run on a calendar. Saturn-ruled and disciplined, they show up consistently once you are on the schedule. Have you booked your slot?

posts.text:
Capricorn math

If i rest i'll fall behind

If i don't rest i'll burn out

So i've decided to burn out efficiently, ahead of schedule
posts.caption: Capricorn ambition is legendary, and so is their complicated relationship with taking a day off. They are the zodiac's CEO even on vacation. Are you resting this weekend or optimizing?

posts.text: Warning: Aquarius has the power to care deeply about the future of humanity and also leave you on read for nine days because they were thinking about octopuses.
posts.caption: Aquarius is the fixed air sign ruled by Uranus, and their brains live somewhere between a science documentary and a protest sign. They love humanity in general and texting back less in particular. What is your Aquarius obsessed with this week?

posts.text:
Would you Rather:

understand an aquarius

OR

understand a dolphin's group chat

(the dolphin will at least reply)
posts.caption: Aquarius is famously unpredictable, original and a little bit unreachable. They are worth the effort, but you need patience and possibly sonar. Which one are you picking?

posts.text: Aquarius moon core is ignoring a text from someone i love and then spending two hours explaining my feelings to a stranger on a train. it felt easier. we're basically family now
posts.caption: An Aquarius moon processes feelings with a bit of distance, which is why strangers sometimes get the full story first. Detached does not mean uncaring, it means it is complicated. Are you this Aquarius moon?

posts.text:
Why you should date an aquarius

1) we're unpredictable
2) we're very loyal
3) we have a theory about the pyramids
4) we'll explain it on the first date

The second date is also about the pyramids
posts.caption: Dating an Aquarius means loyalty, originality and at least one documentary-level theory per dinner. Uranus gives them strange, brilliant minds that never stop asking questions. What theory would your Aquarius bring to the first date?

posts.text: yes that 5'5 pisces moon who cried at a car commercial, believes in your potential more than you do and has fourteen half-written songs about the moon is definitely your soulmate go send them a voice memo right now
posts.caption: A Pisces moon feels everything, dreams big and loves people for who they could become. Neptune makes them romantic, creative and a little bit psychic. Which commercial made your Pisces cry this week?

posts.text:
Being a pisces is wild

One second i'm psychic

The next i've walked into a glass door i walk through every day

The universe gives and the universe takes
posts.caption: Pisces is the mutable water sign ruled by Neptune, so intuition is strong but spatial awareness is optional. They can read your mind but not the room layout. What is your most Pisces moment?

posts.text: PSA: a pisces staring into space is not ignoring you. a pisces is living a full second life in which they own a bakery in portugal. please wait for them to come back.
posts.caption: Pisces placements are the zodiac's daydreamers, with a rich inner world that is frequently more interesting than a meeting. Neptune rules imagination and escape, so they visit often. What is your daydream life?

posts.text: Warning: Pisces has the power to absorb the mood of every single person in the room and then go home and need a nap about it.
posts.caption: Pisces is the most empathic sign in the zodiac, soaking up every feeling like an emotional sponge. That sensitivity is a gift, but it does come with mandatory recovery naps. Do you need a nap after every party too?
